title: Satellite mistaken for object near Jupiter on X

tellings.quote: And so on X, this happened like a year ago. On X, I see people going, "Oh my god, there's a weird thing going around Jupiter or Saturn." It's like, no, it's going around the Earth.

plain: In 2025, people on X passed around an image of what they said was "a weird thing going around Jupiter or Saturn," but the skeptic and writer Michael Shermer says it was a satellite going around the Earth. Shermer tells Michels he watched this play out himself, and he brings it up as an example of how easily ordinary things in the sky get mistaken for something strange.
